patch.value: Enable explicit successful-command Sentry tracing without eager startup

A fresh24h Sentry trace query returned zero rows after a successful read with SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE=1. Successful-command span helpers require an already-initialized client, while current CLI initialization is lazy on error-reporting paths. Preserve that completed startup optimization and add an explicit, bounded tracing opt-in that can initialize and flush successful command spans without manufacturing errors.

Prove an independent successful-command opt-in control before and after; honor consent opt-outs and Vitest isolation; sanitize span context; preserve default cold-start and import budgets; verify one recent explicitly sampled trace through the authenticated Sentry API, distinguishing ingestion unavailability from source behavior.
Explicit opt-in tracing observes successful CLI commands while default startup remains lazy.
